title: Branch Warehouse Terms: Storage of Delivered Factory Production Order Units
content:
**Terms.** Under Factory Production Orders, delivered units wait at the branch warehouse until installation. Calendar days are counted from the day after the branch delivery date, and the last free day carries no charge. Storage is assessed once, on the day installation starts or the contract is cancelled. No storage is charged when the installation has never been offered to the customer inside the free period.

The free storage period, the weekly fee and the cap are figures of the order's build class.

## Clauses no longer in force

1. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "Storage is charged only for days after the free storage period counted from the branch delivery date." The current wording of this condition reads: the condition that storage is charged only for days after the free storage period counted from the branch delivery date governs storage fees alone: neither an expedite fee nor a remake charge falls under it, and every storage fee remains under it.
2. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "Billable days exclude every day of delay caused by an installation reschedule initiated by the company or by weather, and stop on the day installation starts or the order is cancelled." Billable days follow the current basis for branch storage fees.
3. Former wording, **no longer in force**: "Billable days become weeks by counting every started seven-day period as a full week, and the fee is the class fee per unit per week times the units on the order times the weeks, never more than the class cap per order." The fee follows the current basis for branch storage fees.

## The free-period test

| Element | Setting |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the branch delivery date on the factory order record |
| Counting | calendar days, from the day after the branch delivery date |
| Length | the class free storage period |
| Comparison | a storage charge falls only on days after the free period |
| Last free day | carries no charge |

Boundary case (hypothetical, free period of 30 calendar days): units delivered to the branch on 1 June have their 30th free day on 1 July. 1 July carries no charge; 2 July is the first day after the free period.

## Points of judgement

- Storage is assessed once only — on the day installation starts or the day the contract is cancelled — not week by week.
- When the installation was never offered to the customer inside the free period, no storage is charged at all.

superseded_clauses: Storage is charged only for days after the free storage period counted from the branch delivery date.

Billable days (order_msr_billable_storage_days) exclude every day of delay caused by an installation reschedule initiated by the company or by weather, and stop on the day installation starts or the order is cancelled.

Billable days become weeks by counting every started seven-day period as a full week, and the fee is the class fee per unit per week times the units on the order times the weeks, never more than the class cap per order.
